topic.label: JobSeeker
topic.desc: Job seeking end to end: target roles, resume and profile, search, applications, interviews and offers.

concepts: Defining the roles, industries, seniority, location and pay a candidate is aiming for, and where demand for them is.
Resume and professional-profile content tailored to a posting, truthful, readable by applicant tracking systems.
Finding, filtering and ranking postings across job boards and removing duplicates and weak listings.
Cover letters, application tracking, recruiter and referral outreach and follow-ups.
Scheduling, story preparation and practice for behavioral and technical interviews.
Comparing offers, researching the employer and planning a counter-offer.
skills: Builds a target-role profile from the candidate's background, preferences, location and salary range, listing titles to search and deal-breakers.
Reads current postings to report which titles, required skills and salary ranges are in demand for the target role and location.
Builds a ranked shortlist of employers by fit, size, hiring activity and funding signals from company data.
Rewrites resume bullets to match a posting's requirements using only achievements the candidate can support, and maps each keyword to evidence.
Checks keyword coverage and formatting risks that applicant tracking systems parse badly, such as tables, columns and images.
Rewrites the headline, about section and experience entries of an online professional profile so they match the target role.
Runs saved search criteria against job boards and returns postings with title, company, location and a link to the original listing.
Scores each posting against the target-role profile and flags vague pay, unrealistic requirements and repeated reposts.
Detects the same job reposted across boards or dates and keeps one record with every source link.
Drafts a short cover letter for one posting from the tailored resume and the employer research, without inventing experience.
Records each application with stage, date, contact and next follow-up in a tracker database and lists what is overdue.
Drafts referral requests, recruiter messages and follow-ups, each short, specific and easy to decline.
Finds free time on the calendar, creates interview events with preparation reminders and avoids clashes with other interviews.
Turns the candidate's real experience into situation, action, result stories and rehearses them against common behavioral questions.
Builds a practice plan of role-specific questions with mock-interview feedback and a list of weak topics to revisit.
Compares offers on base pay, bonus, equity, benefits and commute using the candidate's own weights, and shows the assumptions.
Plans a counter-offer with a target, a floor and ranked trade-offs, and drafts the message and call talking points.
Researches an employer's stability, funding, reviews and recent news before an offer is accepted and reports what could not be verified.
